basic_info.description: This well-maintained property offers 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom on the main level. The open floor plan features a generous living room, dining area, and kitchen. Oversized windows provide exceptional natural light and stunning, unobstructed city views — bright and airy during the day, with twinkling skyline views at night. Located just a 1-minute walk to Muni public transit and only 5 minutes by car (or 15–20 minutes on foot) to San Francisco State University and H-Mart. The home is situated in a quiet, residential neighborhood with a clean exterior and excellent curb appeal.
